Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES - C34 final round
PR: #277
Head: 5e700abc3e61c0ff273cc7531c5b6c77bc193a3c
Prior reviewed head: f9d2bc77871f3d7cee6418d6d18c86c26d5e40f4
Request: 01a1f6bc-78d5-7851-ace4-87e8efec0c6b

Reviewed only the delta (11 files, +340/-57). Round one's security review
stands for unchanged behavior. No high-confidence security blocker was
identified under C33. The prior global-overflow, local-timeout false-ready,
and lost-on-restart lapse-marker notes are addressed by this delta, subject
to the explicit implementation and proof limits below.

Nonblocking disposition:

C34 follow-up: deterministic tie-breaking for equal-time refusal entries.
registration/refusals.rs:55-58 selects an oldest timestamp through HashMap
iteration. Different timestamps are ordered correctly, but equally oldest
entries have no deterministic tie-breaker. The incoming pair is still
admitted, the bound is retained, and this crosses no authorization boundary.
This is not a final-round security block or a request for another review.

Idle native answers and recovery:

- .copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:737-776,1708-1718,1751-1755 validates
  the response/envelope and cancellation before successful recovery.
  The client's own wait deadline no longer clears its outage.
  The actual R277-1 late-401 test (store.test.mjs:3198-3233) passed with
  zero ready events, one reconnecting event, and one unavailable banner.
- crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:487-492,832-859 keeps the inbox
  bearer-authenticated and rejects paired-machine credentials for it.
  delivery/mod.rs:103-109,1837-1865,1993-2013 requires current native
  session/PID/process-start evidence and an eligible registration.
- delivery/mod.rs:2134-2254,2263-2271 considers the idle timer only after
  actual claim validation/handoff. A timer result is an empty page, not
  delivery or acknowledgement. It cannot turn a refused claim into
  native registration, delivery authority, or an acknowledgement.
- The timer is guarded by native Copilot selection. Ordinary wait clients
  keep their old behavior; existing extension empty-array handling already
  understands the response, so this is not a new wire shape.
- Source reasoning for a message near 54.9 seconds: an in-flight claim is
  not wrapped in the timer. A simultaneous enqueue/deadline can defer work
  to the next poll but does not discard or acknowledge it. This exact
  near-boundary scenario was not locally exercised with a Rust timing test.
- This is not a universal new guarantee about every pre-existing malformed
  individual claim item. Invalid envelope/page metadata and invalid
  consumer proofs retain their separate existing validation.

Spine restoration and poisoning boundaries:

- delivery/mod.rs:52-53,507-550 restores only exact
  native.receiver.lapsed/native.receiver.renewed kinds. It inserts the
  registry seat's ID, not an identifier from event payload text.
- delivery/mod.rs:456-459,769-771 runs OnceCell initialization under
  native_lock before heartbeat/reconciliation uses lapse markers.
  delivery/mod.rs:789-797 prunes noneligible and tombstoned seats.
- crates/store/src/spine.rs:64-65,367-394 binds seat and kind parameters
  and chooses newest sequence, not client time.
  QUERY-BOUND CORRECTION: each eligible seat causes two indexed LIMIT 1
  SELECTs in one snapshot. Restore runs once per daemon, but is not one
  fleet-wide SQL statement. Read count is proportional to eligible seats,
  not spine history; the index is spine_by_seat_kind.
- The exact SQL was independently executed against in-memory SQLite:
  seven checks passed, covering cross-seat and payload-seat spoofing,
  unrelated prefixed kinds, reversed/equal times versus sequence, absence
  of history, bounded query count and indexed execution.
  The observed plan was SEARCH spine_events USING INDEX
  spine_by_seat_kind (seat=? AND kind=?).
- http/governance.rs:581-600,1525-1543 attributes spine appends to the
  resolved actor, not payload-nominated seats. As C33 requires, this does
  not claim cryptographically daemon-only provenance against the local
  user; local-user spine writes are trusted.
- Restore errors log visibly at delivery/mod.rs:521,542-545, after which
  initialization stays complete. Such failure can duplicate audit edges;
  it does not grant receiver liveness or authority.

Refusal eviction and privacy:

- registration/refusals.rs:42-68 holds one mutex while expiring entries,
  suppressing an already-seen pair, evicting an oldest entry at capacity,
  and admitting an unseen pair. A different seat's new pair is no longer
  suppressed by a full window.
- registration/attempts.rs:173-187,218 and registration.rs:214-219,354-403
  expose an internal u64 eviction total while preserving closed refusal
  labels and real-seat observation gating. http/mod.rs:921 includes that
  snapshot in ping. No arbitrary text is projected by refusals_evicted.
- No new token values, credential-bearing fields, environment values or
  machine paths were found in the changed projections/logging/docs.

Independent validation:

1. Parent: exact HEAD and prior-head ancestry verified; clean checkout.
   just pr-freeze 277 passed at this exact head.
   gh pr checks 277 reports all five check groups passed.
   Successful ci run44658829620; successful delivers run44658851605.
   The earlier cancelled delivers run is not used as a success receipt.

2. Exact-head Rust CI:
   rust-test job136031683975 reports 2606 passed and 6 skipped.
   The successful upload log names JUnit artifact14594587460.
   Parent downloaded that exact artifact in memory and verified passes for:
   a_receiver_lapse_and_its_renewal_are_each_told_once;
   a_told_lapse_survives_a_restart_and_is_not_told_again;
   an_idle_native_claim_is_answered_empty_at_the_daemons_bound;
   native_typing_recent_nonempty_draft_does_not_gate_native_claim;
   a_full_window_still_tells_an_unseen_pair_and_counts_what_it_evicts;
   the_window_evicts_what_expired_without_counting_it;
   a_refused_seat_is_told_once_per_code_and_a_made_up_one_never.
   These are actual compiled integration/unit results at the reviewed head,
   not results from an unverified cached local binary.

3. Locally executed exact-source Node tests:
   nice -n 19 node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern="R277-1|inbox wait|idle seat's banner|HTTP non-wait deadlines|foreign TimeoutError|external inbox abort|shutdown during inbox renewal|late stale claim after stop|HTTP skew and refused envelopes|malformed claim hold metadata|native-unavailable retries|outage emits one" .copilot/extensions/pij/store.test.mjs
   PASS: 14 passed, zero failed/cancelled/skipped, 2846.6 ms.

   nice -n 19 node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern="busy native turn consumes|C31: with steering on|C31: a turn-wait hold|native consumer proof rejects|R8:|terminal banner projects|native identity preflight|native success without native message ID" .copilot/extensions/pij/store.test.mjs
   PASS: 14 passed, zero failed/cancelled/skipped, 129.8 ms.

4. Exact-source SQL probe:
   nice -n 19 python3 -B, stdin probe extracting LATEST_MATCHING_SQL and
   applying the repository index migration to in-memory SQLite.
   PASS: seven checks. This is SQL behavior proof, not a local execution
   of compiled Rust restoration; that baseline is supplied by exact-head CI.

5. git diff --check over the reviewed delta passed. Working and staged
   diffs remained empty. No checkout files, dependencies or global settings
   were changed; no local Rust rebuild or cached Rust test binary was used.

Mutation and gate limits:

No independent round-two mutation run was performed or required as a
final-round gate. The author receipt lists FIVE reportedly caught mutants
and ONE survivor (R1-M2, removing the daemon idle bound); it does not support
the packet's statement that all six were caught. These are author claims,
not independent proof.

harness boot --json returned advisory ready:false because this dependency-
free review worktree lacks node_modules. No install or dependency symlink
was created. Full local harness checks was not rerun and is not claimed
green; C25 keeps missing-dependency TS proof CI-only. No live daemon,
deployment, fleet mutation or before/after live-cost measurement was run.

Cost and action scope:

The idle native claim cadence changes from about one request per idle
Copilot seat per65s to one per55s; this is a real per-seat request-rate
increase, not zero new requests. There is no new process launch.
The existing claim loop remains; the native wait gains its answer timer.
Restore adds two indexed bounded reads per eligible seat once per daemon.
At capacity D2 scans at most512 entries for oldest/expiry work per service
refusal; the eviction total is a numeric snapshot.
No new automatic restart or destructive action is introduced.
Live cost acceptance remains separate from this security verdict.
